response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience, deep technical breadth across languages (including C, C++, D, JavaScript/TypeScript), and a proven track record in building scalable systems and open-source tools, but lacks explicit evidence of leading experimentation platforms, telemetry infrastructure, or AI-driven growth systems at enterprise scale — key requirements for this Principal role.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, C, C++, and DLang across high-scale systems
Proven ability to design and ship open-source infrastructure (GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts) with real-world adoption
Strong technical leadership demonstrated through mentoring, workshops, and cross-team tooling contributions
concerns: No clear evidence of building or owning experimentation frameworks, feature flagging, or growth measurement systems
Limited visibility into AI tooling usage to accelerate engineering velocity, a preferred qualification
Experience with distributed systems is implied but not explicitly tied to multi-region, high-availability experimentation platforms
